instruction: Could you disable the screen blank timeout by setting it to 'Never' in the power settings?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling screen blank timeout in GNOME power settings. The evaluator checks if 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay' returns 'uint32 0' (Never/disabled). This uses existing evaluator functions (exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter) - no custom functions needed.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if idle-delay is set to 0 (Never), 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay' which correctly retrieves the screen blank timeout setting
Metric comparison is correct: exact_match compares the command output against the expected value
Expected value is semantically correct: 'uint32 0\n' is the exact output format from gsettings when idle-delay is set to 0 (Never/disabled)
Complete instruction coverage: The evaluator checks that idle-delay equals 0, which directly verifies the instruction requirement to disable screen blank timeout
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts command output string -> Metric performs exact match -> Returns 1.0 if setting is disabled
Edge cases handled: If command fails, getter returns None and metric returns 0.0
